_doc: Single source of truth for every tunable. tools/gen.py turns this into shader uniforms (_<Section><Name>), BepInEx config entries ([Section] Name) and preview sliders. Colours are given in linear RGB; config files show them as sRGB hex.

sections.name: Global
params: Overall brightness of the skin effects
Size of every surface pattern (bigger = larger, calmer patterns)
How much stacked elements share one brightness budget (0 = each at full strength)
Use the triangles' own facing for rims and fresnel (1) instead of the mesh's stored normals (0); faceted, low-poly look and immune to odd mesh normals
Layers drawn just above the skin for flames, ice coat, haze, arcs and aura (0 = off, each layer costs one extra draw)
How far the outermost layer floats above the skin, in metres (for a Greydwarf-sized creature)
Multiplier for every overhaul particle count
Multiplier for every overhaul particle size

sections.name: Fire
params: HDR boost for mid and hot colours (above 1 blooms)
Soft glowing heat patches under the char
Size of the heat patches (bigger = smaller patches)
Warm flickering light the flames cast on the body
Glowing lava seams in the skin (off by default)
How fast the fire pattern climbs
Seconds of burning before the char fully spreads (0 = instant)
Round flickering ember spots in the char
Flame tongues on the layers above the skin
Flame tongue particles per second per m² of body
Flame tongue rise speed in m/s
Rising ember particles per second per m²

sections.name: Frost
params: Brightness of rime, rim and glints
Cold tint over the whole body
How much the crust brightens the surface
How much of the body the crust covers
Seconds for the crust to creep over the body (0 = instant)
Faceted crystal shading on the crust
Fraction of the crust that glints
Glint cells per metre (bigger = smaller glints)
Translucent ice coat on the layers above the skin
Falling flake particles per second per m²

sections.name: Poison
params: How much of the body has veins
How short and punchy each pulse is
How fast pulses travel up the body
Bubbles that swell and pop on the skin
Wet highlight from the sun and rim
Toxic haze on the layers above the skin
Drip particles per second per m²

sections.name: Lightning
params: How much of the body sparks per flash
Arcs slide over the body instead of only flashing
Arc re-randomising rate during a burst
Arcs jumping in the air just above the skin
How hard the creature's light flashes with bursts
Spark particles per second per m²

sections.name: Spirit
params: Darkens the body's interior so it reads as hollow
Ghostly aura on the layers above the skin
Rising wisp particles per second per m²

sections.name: Combos
params: Master switch for all combo effects
How much a combo fades out its parent elements' own looks (1 = only the combo shows)
Combo fire + frost: hissing vapour rises, wet sheen, a faint ember core
Main colour of the Steam combo (also tints the creature's light)
Combo fire + lightning: orange-white arcs crackle over scorched skin
Main colour of the Overload combo (also tints the creature's light)
Combo fire + poison: sickly green flames and green-black smoke
Main colour of the ToxicBurn combo (also tints the creature's light)
Combo fire + spirit: pale blue-white flames with no warmth
Main colour of the GhostFire combo (also tints the creature's light)
Combo frost + lightning: arcs race along the ice cracks
Main colour of the ConductiveIce combo (also tints the creature's light)
Combo frost + poison: dark green veins crystallise under the frost
Main colour of the FrozenVeins combo (also tints the creature's light)
Combo frost + spirit: the body drains of colour, ghostly mist
Main colour of the WraithChill combo (also tints the creature's light)
Combo lightning + poison: green arcs, sizzling bubbles
Main colour of the CorrosiveSparks combo (also tints the creature's light)
Combo lightning + spirit: teal arcs that leave glowing trails
Main colour of the SoulLightning combo (also tints the creature's light)
Combo poison + spirit: purple decay creeps across the skin
Main colour of the Blight combo (also tints the creature's light)
Ragnarok: special effect when all five elements are on one creature
Brightness of Ragnarok's fractures and rings
How fast Ragnarok cycles through the element colours
Ragnarok's core colour (fractures blend toward it, also tints the light)
